title: Luyện TOEIC
tagline: làm theo từng part, chấm ngay từng câu
intro: Đây là bài tập theo đúng định dạng đề TOEIC, khác hẳn bài tập trong các tab khác: đề bài hoàn toàn bằng tiếng Anh, bốn lựa chọn, bối cảnh công sở. Chọn một part rồi làm bao nhiêu câu tùy bạn — mỗi câu chấm ngay và giải thích bằng tiếng Việt. Kết quả cuối buổi chỉ rõ bạn yếu loại câu nào.

parts.name: Hỏi – Đáp
parts.desc: Nghe một câu hỏi rồi chọn 1 trong 3 câu đáp. Không in chữ — chỉ có tiếng.
parts.tip: Nghe cho kỹ TỪ ĐẦU TIÊN: When · Where · Who · Why · How quyết định loại câu trả lời. Bẫy hay gặp nhất là phương án lặp lại một từ vừa nghe hoặc dùng từ nghe giống — gần như luôn sai. Và câu hỏi có chữ or thì không bao giờ trả lời bằng Yes/No.

parts.name: Hội thoại
parts.desc: Nghe một hội thoại rồi trả lời 3 câu. Câu hỏi có in ra — chỉ hội thoại là tiếng.
parts.tip: Đọc ba câu hỏi trước khi bấm nghe — trong phòng thi bạn có khoảng 8 giây để làm việc đó, và nó quyết định điểm phần này. Ba câu hỏi đi theo đúng thứ tự của hội thoại: câu 1 thường ở đầu, câu 3 ở cuối. Câu hỏi What will… next? gần như luôn nằm ở hai lượt cuối cùng.

parts.name: Điền câu
parts.desc: Một câu thiếu một chỗ, chọn 1 trong 4. Kiểm tra ngữ pháp và từ vựng công sở.
parts.tip: Đừng dịch cả câu. Nhìn bốn lựa chọn trước: nếu chúng là bốn dạng của cùng một từ thì câu này hỏi từ loại — chỉ cần nhìn chỗ trống đứng ở vị trí nào trong câu.

parts.name: Đọc hiểu
parts.desc: Một văn bản công sở (email, thông báo, quảng cáo, lịch…) rồi 3 câu hỏi.
parts.tip: Đọc câu hỏi trước, rồi mới quét văn bản tìm chỗ trả lời — đừng đọc kỹ từ đầu. Chú ý phần đầu thư (From / To / Subject): rất nhiều câu hỏi trả lời được ngay từ đó. Câu hỏi có chữ NOT thì ba phương án đúng, một sai — dễ đọc vội thành ngược.

p5.q: All employees must ____ the new safety guidelines before entering the workshop.
p5.why: Sau must phải là động từ nguyên thể. observant tính từ, observation/observance danh từ.

p5.q: The committee's ____ of the proposal came as a surprise to everyone.
p5.why: Sau sở hữu cách committee's và trước of cần một danh từ.

p5.q: Ms Tran handled the complaint ____ and the client renewed the contract.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ handled thì cần trạng từ.

p5.q: The new software has made the billing process considerably more ____.
p5.why: Sau more trong cấu trúc so sánh cần tính từ, vì nó mô tả process.

p5.q: Please submit your ____ for travel costs by the end of the month.
p5.why: Sau your cần danh từ làm tân ngữ của submit.

p5.q: The maintenance team works ____ with the security staff on weekends.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho works nên cần trạng từ. close cũng là trạng từ nhưng mang nghĩa khoảng cách vật lý.

p5.q: We received several ____ about the noise from the construction site.
p5.why: Sau several cần danh từ đếm được số nhiều.

p5.q: The report was ____ researched but poorly organised.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho phân từ researched nên cần trạng từ.

p5.q: By the time the auditors arrived, the finance team ____ all the documents.
p5.why: Việc xảy ra TRƯỚC một mốc quá khứ khác dùng quá khứ hoàn thành.

p5.q: The factory ____ in operation since the company was founded in 1998.
p5.why: since + mốc quá khứ, việc kéo dài đến nay → hiện tại hoàn thành.

p5.q: If the shipment ____ delayed again, we will have to find another supplier.
p5.why: Điều kiện loại 1: vế if dùng hiện tại đơn, không dùng will.

p5.q: The quarterly figures ____ by an independent firm every year.
p5.why: figures được xem xét chứ không tự xem → bị động.

p5.q: Mr Lam suggested that the meeting ____ until the following week.
p5.why: Sau suggest that dùng thức giả định: động từ ở dạng trần, đây là bị động nên be postponed.

p5.q: Please note that the office ____ at noon on the last Friday of each month.
p5.why: Lịch cố định lặp lại dùng hiện tại đơn.

p5.q: The technician ____ the equipment when the power suddenly went out.
p5.why: Việc đang diễn ra thì bị cắt ngang → quá khứ tiếp diễn.

p5.q: The conference will be held ____ the Grand Hotel on 14 May.
p5.why: at dùng với một địa điểm cụ thể được coi là một điểm.

p5.q: All applications must be submitted ____ Friday at the latest.
p5.why: by = chậm nhất là. until nhấn vào việc kéo dài liên tục tới lúc đó.

p5.q: Sales have increased sharply ____ the past six months.
p5.why: over + khoảng thời gian = trong suốt khoảng đó.

p5.q: The department is responsible ____ processing all incoming invoices.
p5.why: responsible đi cố định với for.

p5.q: Our office is located ____ the train station and the shopping centre.
p5.why: between dùng cho đúng hai mốc; among cho từ ba trở lên.

p5.q: ____ the heavy rain, the outdoor event went ahead as planned.
p5.why: Despite + danh từ. Although cần cả mệnh đề.

p5.q: The supplier raised its prices, ____ we decided to look elsewhere.
p5.why: Vế sau là kết quả của vế trước nên dùng so.

p5.q: We cannot process the refund ____ you provide the original receipt.
p5.why: unless = nếu không. Câu mang nghĩa phủ định điều kiện.

p5.q: The presentation was informative. ____, it ran forty minutes over time.
p5.why: Hai vế trái chiều nhau nên cần từ nối tương phản.

p5.q: Staff may use the parking area ____ they display a valid permit.
p5.why: as long as nêu điều kiện bắt buộc để được phép.

p5.q: The new interns introduced ____ to the department on Monday.
p5.why: Chủ ngữ và tân ngữ là cùng một người nên dùng đại từ phản thân.

p5.q: ____ of the two candidates has the experience we need.
p5.why: Neither dùng cho đúng hai, đi với động từ số ít has.

p5.q: The manager whose department exceeded its target will receive ____ bonus first.
p5.why: Lần đầu nhắc tới một khoản thưởng chưa xác định nên dùng a.

p5.q: The hotel offers a shuttle service at no ____ charge to all guests.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ charge nên cần tính từ; no additional charge = không tính thêm phí.

p5.q: Please ____ the attached file for the full breakdown of costs.
p5.why: refer to = xem, tham khảo. Động từ này bắt buộc có to.

p5.q: The warehouse keeps a detailed ____ of every item that enters the building.
p5.why: record = bản ghi, hồ sơ. recording là bản thu âm/thu hình.

p5.q: Our supplier was unable to ____ the order within the agreed timeframe.
p5.why: fulfil an order là cụm cố định = hoàn tất đơn hàng.

p5.q: The firm has decided to ____ its operations into three new markets.
p5.why: expand = mở rộng. expend = tiêu hao, dễ nhầm.

p5.q: All visitors are required to ____ a badge while on the premises.
p5.why: wear a badge là cụm chuẩn. dress không đi với a badge.

p5.q: The contract will ____ automatically unless either party gives notice.
p5.why: renew a contract = gia hạn hợp đồng. renovate dùng cho nhà cửa.

p5.q: Please make sure the invoice ____ the correct purchase order number.
p5.why: include = có chứa. consist phải đi với of, và comprise không dùng of.

p5.q: The training session has been ____ to the first week of June.
p5.why: reschedule = dời lịch. Ba từ kia không mang nghĩa đổi thời gian.

p5.q: We apologise for any ____ caused by the lift being out of service.
p5.why: Sau any cần danh từ; inconvenience là danh từ không đếm được.

p5.q: The analyst's findings are ____ with the results of last year's survey.
p5.why: be consistent with = nhất quán với. Cụm cố định hay gặp trong báo cáo.

p5.q: Employees who wish to ____ for the position should contact HR directly.
p5.why: Sau wish to cần động từ nguyên thể; apply for = nộp đơn.

p5.q: The delivery charge is ____ for orders over two million dong.
p5.why: waive a charge = miễn phí. wave là vẫy tay, rất dễ nhầm chính tả.

p5.q: Attendance at the safety briefing is ____ for all new staff.
p5.why: mandatory = bắt buộc. Ba từ kia đều mang nghĩa không bắt buộc.

p5.q: The committee reached its decision after a ____ review of all the data.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ review nên cần tính từ.

p5.q: Her ____ to the project was recognised at the annual awards ceremony.
p5.why: Sau Her và làm chủ ngữ của câu nên cần danh từ chỉ sự việc, không phải người.

p5.q: The instructions were written ____ enough for anyone to follow.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho written nên cần trạng từ; clearly enough đúng trật tự.

p5.q: We need a more ____ approach to managing our inventory.
p5.why: Sau more và trước danh từ approach cần tính từ.

p5.q: The ____ of the new branch has been delayed until September.
p5.why: Sau The và trước of cần danh từ; opening ở đây là danh động từ.

p5.q: Next Monday the board ____ the budget for the coming financial year.
p5.why: Next Monday là mốc tương lai nên dùng will + V.

p5.q: The samples ____ to the laboratory before the deadline yesterday.
p5.why: Mẫu vật được gửi chứ không tự gửi, và mốc là yesterday → bị động quá khứ.

p5.q: Staff are reminded ____ their identification at all times.
p5.why: remind somebody to V — ở dạng bị động vẫn giữ to V.

p5.q: The company ____ its headquarters to Da Nang three years ago.
p5.why: three years ago là mốc quá khứ đã kết thúc → quá khứ đơn.

p5.q: The policy applies to all employees ____ their length of service.
p5.why: regardless of = bất kể. despite không bao giờ đi với of.

p5.q: Please complete the form ____ ink and return it to reception.
p5.why: in ink, in pencil là cụm cố định chỉ phương tiện viết.

p5.q: The figures in this column are given ____ thousands of units.
p5.why: in thousands chỉ đơn vị đo.

p5.q: ____ the manager approves the request, the order cannot be placed.
p5.why: Until = cho đến khi. Câu nghĩa: chưa duyệt thì chưa đặt được hàng.

p5.q: The hotel has a gym, a pool ____ a business centre on the top floor.
p5.why: as well as nối hai danh từ. as well chỉ đứng cuối câu.

p5.q: Sales rose in the north ____ they fell slightly in the south.
p5.why: whereas dùng để đối chiếu hai vế trái ngược.

p5.q: The consultant ____ report we discussed will join us on Thursday.
p5.why: whose chỉ sở hữu: bản báo cáo của người tư vấn đó.

p5.q: The building, ____ was completed last year, already needs repairs.
p5.why: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy) không dùng that.

p5.q: This year's turnover was almost twice ____ last year's.
p5.why: Cấu trúc gấp bội: twice + as + tính từ + as.

p7.label: Email
p7.title: Request to reschedule
head: From
h.pham@vinatex-supply.com
To
m.okafor@brightline.co.uk
Date
3 March
Subject
Thursday's review meeting
text: Dear Ms Okafor,

I am writing about the contract review scheduled for this Thursday at 10 a.m. Unfortunately, our logistics manager has been called to the Hai Phong site and will not be back before Friday afternoon. As he prepared most of the shipping figures, holding the meeting without him would not be productive.

Would it be possible to move the review to Monday 9 March, at the same time? If Monday does not suit you, we are also free on Tuesday morning. I will send the revised cost tables as soon as they are approved, so that you have them at least two days in advance.
I apologise for the short notice. Please let me know which option works better for you.

Kind regards,
Hoa Pham
Contracts Officer

qs.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
opts: To request a change of date for a meeting
To cancel a contract with a supplier
To introduce a new logistics manager
To complain about a late delivery
qs.why: Câu mở đầu đoạn hai nêu rõ: Would it be possible to move the review to Monday — mục đích là xin dời lịch.

qs.q: Why can the logistics manager not attend?
opts: He has been sent to another site
qs.why: has been called to the Hai Phong site and will not be back before Friday afternoon.

qs.q: What does Ms Pham suggest she will do before the new meeting?
qs.why: I will send the revised cost tables… at least two days in advance. Ba phương án kia không được nhắc tới.

p7.label: Thông báo
p7.title: Lift maintenance — Block B
head: Posted
12 June
Location
All floors, Block B
text: NOTICE TO ALL OCCUPANTS

The two passenger lifts in Block B will undergo their annual safety inspection from Monday 17 June to Wednesday 19 June. Lift 1 will be out of service on Monday and Tuesday; Lift 2 will be out of service on Wednesday only. At no point will both lifts be unavailable at the same time.
The service lift at the rear of the building may be used by anyone during these three days. Please note that it does not stop on the fourth floor.
Staff who require assistance moving between floors should contact the building office on extension 204 at least one day in advance.
We apologise for the inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation.

qs.q: When will Lift 2 be unavailable?
qs.why: Lift 2 will be out of service on Wednesday only.

qs.q: What is NOT true about the service lift?
opts: It is at the rear of the building
Anyone may use it during the works
It is available for three days
qs.why: Thông báo ghi rõ it does not stop on the fourth floor, nên phương án "dừng ở mọi tầng" là sai.

qs.q: What should someone needing help do?
opts: Use the stairs in Block A
Telephone the building office a day earlier
qs.why: contact the building office on extension 204 at least one day in advance.

p7.label: Tin tuyển dụng
p7.title: Warehouse Coordinator — Da Nang
head: Company
Mekong Freight Services
Closing date
28 August
text: WAREHOUSE COORDINATOR — DA NANG

Mekong Freight Services is seeking a Warehouse Coordinator to join our expanding distribution centre. The successful candidate will oversee daily stock movements, maintain accurate inventory records and liaise with our courier partners.

Requirements: at least two years' experience in a warehouse or logistics role; confident use of inventory software; working English, as half our vendors are based overseas. A forklift licence is an advantage but not essential — training can be provided.
We offer a competitive salary, quarterly performance bonuses and full health cover from the first day of employment.
To apply, send your CV and a short covering letter to careers@mekongfreight.vn. Please quote reference WC-DN-08. Applications without a reference number cannot be processed.

qs.q: Which requirement is described as optional?
qs.why: A forklift licence is an advantage but not essential.

qs.q: Why is English needed for the role?
opts: Many of the company's vendors are abroad
The software is only in English
Staff meetings are held in English
qs.why: working English, as half our vendors are based overseas.

qs.q: What must applicants include?
opts: A copy of their forklift licence
qs.why: Applications without a reference number cannot be processed.

p7.label: Thông báo nội bộ
p7.title: Revised home-working policy
head: To
All staff
From
Human Resources
Date
2 October
text: Following the trial that ran from April to September, the home-working arrangement will become permanent from 1 November, with two changes.

First, the number of home days rises from two to three per week. Teams must still agree a shared office day so that everyone is present at least once a week; departments are free to choose which day that is.

Second, equipment requests are moving from the IT helpdesk to the facilities team. Anyone who needs a monitor, chair or headset at home should submit a single request through the facilities portal. Requests sent to IT after 1 November will be redirected, which may add several days.
The trial survey showed that the main difficulty was not technology but meeting times. Managers are asked to schedule team meetings on the shared office day wherever possible.
Questions about the policy should go to your line manager in the first instance.

qs.q: What is the memo mainly about?
opts: The start of a new home-working trial
Changes to an existing home-working arrangement
qs.why: Câu đầu nói rõ chính sách thử nghiệm nay thành chính thức, with two changes.

qs.q: Where should equipment requests be sent after 1 November?
qs.why: equipment requests are moving from the IT helpdesk to the facilities team… through the facilities portal.

qs.q: What problem did the trial reveal?
qs.why: the main difficulty was not technology but meeting times.

p7.label: Lịch chương trình
p7.title: Regional Sales Conference — Day 1
head: Venue
Riverside Hotel, Hue

Friday 14 November
text: 08:30 – 09:00   Registration and coffee — Main Lobby
09:00 – 09:20   Opening remarks — Ms L. Trinh, Regional Director — Hall A

qs.q: What happens immediately after lunch?
qs.why: Lịch ghi 13:30 – 15:00 Breakout groups by territory, ngay sau bữa trưa kết thúc lúc 13:30.

qs.q: What must delegates do to join the workshop?
opts: Bring a copy of the agenda
Sign up at the desk before 9 a.m.
qs.why: must sign up at the registration desk before 09:00. Spaces cannot be reserved in advance.

qs.q: Which session is most likely to be the largest?
qs.why: Phiên này ở Hall A và không giới hạn chỗ, trong khi workshop chỉ 30 người và breakout chia ra ba phòng.

p7.label: Tin nhắn
p7.title: Message chain — delivery problem
head: Participants
T. Nguyen · D. Carter
Time
text: T. Nguyen  09:12   Morning. The pallets that arrived yesterday are short — we counted 18, the dispatch note says 24.
D. Carter  09:15   That's odd. Let me check with the warehouse. Did the driver sign anything?
T. Nguyen  09:17   He signed our receipt but wrote "count not verified" next to it.
D. Carter  09:23   Found it. Six pallets were held back because the second truck failed its inspection. They're going out this afternoon.
T. Nguyen  09:25   Afternoon won't work — the line stops at two if we're short.
D. Carter  09:28   Understood. I'll put them on the express courier instead. Should reach you by eleven.
T. Nguyen  09:31   That works. Send me the tracking number when you have it.

qs.q: Why did Mr Nguyen send the first message?
opts: To report that part of a delivery was missing
To complain about a damaged pallet
qs.why: we counted 18, the dispatch note says 24 — thiếu hàng.

qs.q: What caused the shortage?
opts: A second truck failed an inspection
The driver took the wrong route
qs.why: Six pallets were held back because the second truck failed its inspection.

qs.q: At 09:25, what does Mr Nguyen mean by "Afternoon won't work"?
opts: He will not be at the site in the afternoon
The courier does not deliver in the afternoon
The goods would arrive too late to keep the line running
qs.why: Câu sau giải thích: the line stops at two if we're short.

p7.label: Thư
p7.title: Complaint about a recurring fault
head: From
Orchid Court Residents' Association
To
Customer Relations, Vertex Climate Ltd
Date
9 January
text: Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing on behalf of the residents of Orchid Court regarding the air-conditioning units installed in our common areas in March last year.

Since October the units on the second and third floors have shut down without warning, sometimes several times a week. Your engineers have visited on four occasions. On each visit the system was restarted and we were told the fault was a sensor; on no occasion was a part replaced.

Under the terms of our maintenance agreement, a recurring fault reported three times within six months entitles us to a full replacement at no cost. We have now reported this fault four times, and we are therefore requesting replacement of both units.
I would be grateful for a written response within fourteen days. If we do not hear from you, we will refer the matter to the installers' trade association.

Yours faithfully,
K. Vu
Chair, Residents' Association

qs.q: How many times have engineers visited?
qs.why: Your engineers have visited on four occasions.

qs.q: What is Ms Vu requesting?
opts: That both units be replaced free of charge
That the units be repaired within fourteen days
A refund of the installation cost
qs.why: we are therefore requesting replacement of both units, theo điều khoản miễn phí trong hợp đồng.

qs.q: In paragraph 3, the phrase "entitles us to" is closest in meaning to
qs.why: entitle somebody to something = cho ai quyền được hưởng gì.

p7.label: Bản tin
p7.title: Local firm opens second plant
head: Source
Dong Nai Business Weekly
Date
22 May
text: Thanh Loc Packaging will open a second production plant in Bien Hoa this September, creating around 140 jobs in the district.

The company, founded in 2004, currently supplies cardboard packaging to food producers across the south. Demand has grown steadily since 2021, and managing director Vu Dinh Quang said the existing plant had been running at full capacity for over a year. "We were turning away orders," he said. "That is a pleasant problem, but it is still a problem."
The new facility will focus on recycled board, a line the company has not produced before. Mr Quang expects recycled products to account for about a third of output within three years.
Recruitment begins in July. The company says it will give priority to applicants from the surrounding wards, and that no previous experience is required for most production roles.
Construction is already under way and is reported to be two weeks ahead of schedule.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
opts: A company moving to a new location
A merger between two packaging firms
A fall in demand for packaging
A company expanding with a new plant
qs.why: Câu đầu nêu rõ: mở nhà máy thứ hai, tạo 140 việc làm.

qs.q: What is new about the second plant?
opts: It will be larger than the first
qs.why: The new facility will focus on recycled board, a line the company has not produced before.

qs.q: Why did the company decide to expand?
opts: It could not meet existing demand
qs.why: running at full capacity for over a year và We were turning away orders.

p2.q: When does the shipment arrive?
p2.why: Câu hỏi When đòi một mốc thời gian.
p2.trap: It's quite heavy bắt vào chữ shipment nhưng trả lời sai loại câu hỏi; Yes không bao giờ trả lời được câu hỏi Wh-.
